source_version: Live Scryfall run 39741683804 passed all five full lists on Oct 22; official 40K source audit 2026-10-12 and corrected errata Oct 22
study_problem: Owner's current preferred 100 cuts MV0 Inevitable Betrayal; competing keeper-cut 100 retains it. Bounded previous effect models don't resolve physically real cascade-to-Betrayal nor represent what PUT an opponent creature means for Keeper and Lost triggers. Build the minimum direct differential cases, not a full game.

registered_cases.expected: Paid hand MV3 Grinning Ignus, X=9, actual MV0 Inevitable Betrayal from physically sourced library cast for free; no Abaddon-granted cascade on it; Lost makes one Spawn; one enemy creature put (not cast) under our control; no Keeper damage from a creature put
Actual cast still makes one Spawn; opponent library has no creature, so search finds none and no creature enters
Actual cast triggers Lost before opponent counters; countered spell goes to owner's graveyard; opponent creature not moved
Physical MV0 spell exiled via cascade but cannot be cast from exile under Drannith; no Lost spawn and no opponent search
Hand Ignus is prior cast; Rule of Law denies subsequent free cascade hit; no Spawn/creature theft
Keeping Keeper and Lost while hitting physical MV1 Sol Ring yields Spawn and targeted 1 damage; physical MV0 Lotus Petal yields Spawn but zero Keeper damage; neither makes opponent creature enter

fixture_rules: Use shared exact 99 named source fixture, Abaddon+Birgi+Loyal and X=9, source-paid Ignus at postcombat main, one physically rearranged cascade hit (not a probability observation); explicit hypothetical opponent 3-card library separate from own physical 99 with exactly one named Baleful Strix creature and two lands, or no creatures. Conditional opponent counter/hate is an adversarial event; no opponent win simulation.
payability: Ignus from hand costs 2R; pay from named Island/Swamp/Mountain in existing source model; spell is MV3 and commander grants cascade iff X >=3. Cascade eligible hit must be strictly MV <3; Inevitable Betrayal is MV0 with no hand mana cost, free cast legal only from exile if target opponent is legal; Sol Ring is MV1; Lotus Petal MV0.
targeted_endpoints: opponent library creature moves from library to battlefield under your control only on spell resolution, no second spell cast
nonhand-cast count and Spawn trigger =1 when allowed and cast, zero when blocked
Keeper triggered targeted damage = hit mana value when on battlefield, 0 for MV0, and never off a merely put creature
counter-after-cast preserves triggered Spawn but not theft
limitations: Cannot establish incidence/value of stealing opponent creature, or empirical strength of preferred package
Cannot infer Keeper in battlefield from its deck inclusion; field is preregistered conditional only
External opponent library is conditional explicit fixture, not invented as an actual user's card
No all-99-card effect model, no stochastic trial, no decision reversal or M6 certification
choice_reversal_threshold: A tested interaction demonstrating Betrayal creates an additional Keeper trigger via putting a creature or returns reliably multiple cast triggers would directly undermine the present cut argument; otherwise leave preferred package a justified qualitative judgment. Source access cannot adjudicate creature-rich metagame.
stop_rule: Six deterministic bounded cases plus independent reproduction of previously recorded P0 modules selected in the case registry, 0 randomized runs; if missing test ref or source model wrong, fail exact-head CI and preserve unresolved.
